title: build(deps-dev): bump postcss from 8.5.30 to 8.5.31
intent: Build-toolchain currency, no advisory. postcss 8.5.31: 'Fix better source map on </style> escaping' -- a follow-up to 8.5.29/8.5.30's SafeStringifier, touching lib/stringify.js and lib/processor.js (version string) only. Unlike the 8.5.30 bump (PR #449), postcss 8.5.31 raises no dependency floors, so nothing moves transitively. GitHub's advisory API returns 0 advisories for postcss@8.5.31.
behavior_change: None in shipped output, verified by building. Lockfile vs merge base 02032884: 400 entries before and after, ZERO added, ZERO removed, exactly ONE node_modules entry changed: postcss 8.5.30 -> 8.5.31 (version, resolved, integrity; dependency map unchanged, so nanoid/source-map-js do not move). Root differs only in devDependencies.postcss ^8.5.30 -> ^8.5.31. Not dev-only in practice (vue -> @vue/compiler-sfc -> postcss), but it is a build-time compiler. A/B vite build: 199 vs 199 files, diff -rq reports ZERO differences -- byte-identical. The pre-existing phantom 'nanoid' dependency recorded in postcss-8.5.30-bump.json is unchanged by this PR.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves devDependencies.postcss from ^8.5.30 to ^8.5.31. package-lock.json resolves postcss 8.5.30 -> 8.5.31 and updates the root range. Dependabot's incidental peer-flag churn on 16 unchanged-version entries was reverted so nothing else moves.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency; this manifest exists because Dependabot cannot author one (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001). No existing manifest covers this diff, and borrowing one is what the rule refuses -- PR #296's silent zod 4 -> 3 revert is why.

commands_run: Merge base with origin/main = 02032884 = origin/main at audit (0 behind).
Lockfile enumerated as data (both package-lock.json trees parsed, every `packages` entry compared in full), not read from the diff view.

Dependabot's npm flipped the 'peer' flag on 16 entries with unchanged versions; per the convention set in ec88eedd (#432) that churn is reverted -- the committed lockfile is the merge-base lockfile plus the real deltas only (re-enumerated after the revert: zero peer-flag differences remain).
Integrity of every moved entry == `npm view <pkg>@<ver> dist.integrity`; published via GitHub Actions OIDC with SLSA provenance; no preinstall/install/postinstall scripts.
A/B production build: npm ci + vite build in a worktree at origin/main and in this branch's worktree, outputs compared with diff -rq.
py -3.11 scripts/ci/check_cbsp21_gate.py --changed-files <PR files> and scripts/ci/check_cbsp21_patch_input.py run locally before push.
npm pack postcss@8.5.30 and @8.5.31, diff -r: 3 files (lib/processor.js, lib/stringify.js, package.json version); no install scripts; no new network/eval/process tokens.
A/B vite build: 199 vs 199 files, diff -rq: no differences.
